overview: Chile is a long, narrow country on the western side of South America, between the Andes and the Pacific Ocean. Its capital and largest city is Santiago. Chile won independence from Spain in 1818. It is one of the world's biggest producers of copper, and it also owns Easter Island, far out in the Pacific, which is famous for its giant stone statues.

geography.text: Chile is more than 4,000 kilometres long but on average less than 200 kilometres wide. In the north is the Atacama Desert, one of the driest places on Earth. The centre has a mild climate and most of the people, while the south breaks up into forests, fjords, glaciers and islands all the way to Cape Horn. The Andes run along the whole eastern border.
